thread:
Mia Chen: quick sync: proposing a lightweight sampled-inspect flow for latency-sensitive routes (/v1/generate). goal = keep main-path tiny while giving SRE/support occasional full captures for debugging.
Samir Patel: makes sense. what are the numbers? we should avoid surprising customers with hidden charges.
Mia Chen: draft numbers: always emit minimal telemetry (latency, token_count, route, tenant_id hash). full_capture_rate: 0.005 (0.5%) by default. redact_level: high -> PII heuristics + fuzzy masks. inspect_retention: 1h default.
Lee Gomez: 0.5% ok. we need a console "inspect budget" meter (used/remaining tokens) per-tenant and a per-route effective rate display. customers will ask why support can't see traces.
Anya Rivera: privacy: full captures must pseudonymize identifiers (emails, phone, SSNs). any unmask action must create an immutable audit entry (who, why, timestamp).
Zack Cole: runtime: do NOT block request on capture. write a compact provenance record inline and async push the full blob to capture service. enqueue must be best-effort; if queue full, drop and emit metrics.
Mia Chen: agreed. plan = inline fingerprint + async upload. enqueue should not alter request SLO.
Samir Patel: support replay flow idea: short-lived HMAC token (15m TTL) that authorizes fetching a redacted-plus-pseudonymized payload. admin approval required. store audit log entry.
Anya Rivera: opt-in per-tenant. legal holds may extend retention. surface retention + opt-in state in console.
Emily Tran: console copy: label toggle "Enable sampled inspect captures (may incur inspect usage)" tooltip: "A small percent of requests are captured and stored redacted by default. Support can request temporary unmask; all access is audited." add link to billing for inspect tokens.
Lee Gomez: implement inspect quota separate from request quota so captured tokens don't affect normal customer quota math. otherwise they get double-charged confusion.
Zack Cole: use a token-weight model: full capture consumes inspect_tokens proportional to payload size. makes quota accounting and rate-limits clear.
Mia Chen: how do we expose runtime effective sampling (global default, tenant override, canary multiplier)?
Samir Patel: expose `effective_capture_rate` and `capture_rate_source` (global|tenant|canary) in the per-route API and console.
Anya Rivera: require admin role to enable unmask + separate permission to view audit logs. limit human eyes.
ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: telemetry-capture-service v2 -> canary on prod at 2026-03-22T02:00Z.
Mia Chen: I'll write RFC with config schema + console mock + support runbook. please ping with blockers. :thumbsup:
Zack Cole: small perf nit: make sampling decision deterministic (hash request-id) when possible so captures align with caching and reduce variance.
Emily Tran: minor edit to tooltip: "Captured requests are redacted by default. To request a temporary unmask, contact Support; access is audited."
Samir Patel: ack. if no flags by EOD I'll merge and kick off canary.
Mia Chen: merging tomorrow unless someone objects.
Anya Rivera: privacy approved; filing follow-up to sync retention windows with legal.
